lines: "Indeed, I found a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne."
A rich land in the south. A great throne. A strong army.
"I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah."
A whole nation, every morning, bowing to the sun. The sun that Allah Himself had made.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, did not send an army. He said: "We will see whether you were truthful, or were of the liars."
